  Nc1cc(F)ccc1 -> attached to N of the amide, and the phenyl ring has F at position 3 (relative to N) and C(=O)C(F)(F)F at position 4.
  So the molecule is N-(3-fluoro-4-(2,2,2-trifluoroacetyl)phenyl)-2-phenylacetamide.

Reaction type: Oxidations.
In oxidation reactions in retrosynthesis, we typically look for a less oxidized precursor that gets oxidized to the product.

Usually, oxidation of a methyl/methylene group adjacent to an aromatic ring gives a carbonyl.
So the precursor would be O=C(CCc1ccccc1)Nc1cc(F)ccc1CC(F)(F)F.
